title: mesh_manifest
description: EchoForge mesh_manifest document. Describes a triangulated surface mesh asset (source files, format, units, geometric counts, and integrity hash) consumed by EM solvers. Conforms to the EchoForge strict-open contract: deterministic id, public-proxy provenance, and validation envelope.

id.description: Deterministic EchoForge id of the form ef:<kind>:<public_proxy_id>:<16hex>:1. Derived from the identity-field payload.

kind.description: Document kind discriminator. Always the literal string 'mesh_manifest' for this schema.

schema_version.description: EchoForge schema version pin. Must equal '1.0.0' for this revision of the contract.

public_proxy_id.description: Stable, human-readable slug identifying the public-proxy mesh subject (lowercase letters, digits, and ._- separators). Forms part of the deterministic id.

provenance.description: Provenance envelope: how the document was produced, source references, generator, timestamp, and payload fingerprint.

license.description: License envelope (SPDX id and optional notice) under which the mesh manifest content is released.

validation.description: Validation envelope: tier, overall status, uncertainty score, and the per-check results that establish trust in this document.

mesh_name.description: Human-readable mesh name shown in tools and reports. Non-empty free text.

mesh_format.description: Mesh container format. Examples: glb | gltf | stl | obj | ply | step. Free-form non-empty string (no strict enum at the schema layer).

source_files.description: Ordered list of source-file paths (relative to bundle root) composing the mesh asset. At least one entry is required and each entry must be a non-empty string.

units.description: Length units of the mesh coordinates. Examples: m | mm | cm | in. Non-empty string.

triangle_count.description: Total number of triangular faces in the mesh. Must be a positive integer (>= 1).

watertight.description: True if the mesh is closed/manifold (no boundary edges), false otherwise.

mesh_sha256.description: SHA-256 content hash of the canonical mesh payload, encoded as 64 lowercase hex characters. Used for integrity verification and dedup.
